## Boundary Check

- [ ] MDPR deterministic runtime ownership is unchanged, or the runtime change is explicitly described.
- [ ] mdpr-skill outputs remain hints, reviews, proposals, or documentation unless an approved bridge contract applies.
- [ ] The change does not introduce final coordinates, exact colors, z-order, arrow geometry, shape geometry, renderer object IDs, or exact icon choices into agent-owned outputs.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior follows SECURITY.md.
